shared_elements: bearded male figure with elaborately rendered curled hair/beard
stone relief with figures on a groundline
patterned infill for hair, feathers, fleece rendered as rows of scales/curls
justification: Both depict low-relief profile male figures with meticulously patterned curled hair and beards, standing on a groundline and extending a hand toward an object, and both use dense repeating scale-like patterning to fill textured surfaces (wings in A, fleece and foliage in B). But A is a single frontal-bodied winged composite being with a bird-of-prey head holding a bucket, filling the whole panel, whereas B is a horizontal procession of several wingless human attendants leading rams past a tree with border bands — different subject and compositional scheme.
